newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's sets 'George of the Jungle' price offer.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's sets 'George of the Jungle' price offer.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Wednesday it set a price promotion for its Quarter Pounder with Cheese hamburger and Sausage McMuffin with Egg breakfast sandwich, as part of its tie-in with the George of the Jungle movie.
Under a national promotion offered by participating restaurants, two Quarter Pounders or two Sausage McMuffins will be sold for $2.
Other menu promotions include tropical fruit flavored shakes and island pineapple pie, McDonald's added.
McDonald's promotional tie-in to the George of the Jungle live-action film is part of its ongoing marketing alliance with Walt Disney Co.
